name: Jake Solomon
notes: Known from the mWa roleplay packet of 1 December 1999, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 2 December 1999 and served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/minooka-wrestling-alliance-rp-packet-12-1-99-part-1-1999-12-02.html. Jake Solomon is interviewed by the reporter James Miller in a prison visiting room, where he is prisoner 1985; he says he joined the mWa to get a short hour out of the prison, and a flashback shows how a party in Atlantic City on 14 October 1998 ended with him beating a man with a shovel, for which he faces at least twenty years.
caption: A prison inmate who joins the restarted mWa for a short hour of freedom, telling reporter James Miller how a party brawl put him away.

tenures.source: /promotions/rspwf/archive/minooka-wrestling-alliance-rp-packet-12-1-99-part-1-1999-12-02.html (the mWa roleplay packet of 12/1/99, in which he is lined up first)

name: Assassin
notes: Known from the mWa roleplay packet of 1 December 1999, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 2 December 1999 and served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/minooka-wrestling-alliance-rp-packet-12-1-99-part-1-1999-12-02.html. Assassin is a small but well-built Montanan in an "aWo" shirt who drives a black Mercedes convertible, introduces himself to a beach dancer as an mWa wrestler, promises to win the tournament, and ends the scene with the dancer beating him and him taking his temper out on two small children. The mWa's Youthenasia names him with Pico Flush and Tiger among the old guard.
caption: A Montanan mWa wrestler whose beach flirtation with a dancer ends in a beating, in the restarted league's December 1999 packet.

name: "The Epitome" Dillon McCain
notes: Known from the mWa roleplay packet of 1 December 1999, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 2 December 1999 and served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/minooka-wrestling-alliance-rp-packet-12-1-99-part-1-1999-12-02.html. McCain is half of Youthenasia with Ethan Van Ryan: in a rooftop segment, filmed on a camera he found in Ben Dover's dressing room, he introduces himself as the epitome of everything wrestlers aspire to be, calls out Pico Flush, Assassin and Tiger as the old guard, and gives the team's motto: "Out with the OLD, and in with the NEW".
caption: Half of the new mWa team Youthenasia, calling the old guard out from a rooftop in December 1999.

name: Ethan Van Ryan
notes: Known from the mWa roleplay packet of 1 December 1999, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 2 December 1999 and served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/minooka-wrestling-alliance-rp-packet-12-1-99-part-1-1999-12-02.html. Van Ryan, a blond wrestler from Seattle in a leather coat, is the quieter half of Youthenasia with Dillon McCain; on the roof he says the pair were invited by the mWa's president in person, mocks Minooka as a wasteland, claims to have survived Heaven and Hell and ThunderDome matches, and rates Jeff Tiger the best the mWa has, after himself and McCain.
caption: The blond Seattle half of Youthenasia, scorning Minooka as a wasteland from a rooftop in December 1999.

name: Jeff Tiger
notes: Known from the mWa roleplay packet of 1 December 1999, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 2 December 1999 and served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/minooka-wrestling-alliance-rp-packet-12-1-99-part-1-1999-12-02.html. Jeff Tiger, formerly Red Tiger, returns to the mWa in the arena parking lot with longer hair, more muscle, dark shades, a Family Values Tour shirt and a leather jacket, calling himself the Definition of Perfection, saying he has dropped his lucha libre past, and recalling a call asking him to draw ratings for the league. The post is cut off in his promo.
caption: The returning former Red Tiger, who calls himself the Definition of Perfection as the mWa restarts in December 1999.
